        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))

ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.

    SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "/app/src/INPUT.DAT"
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
    SELECT OUTPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "/app/data/OUTPUT.DAT"

DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD INPUT-FILE.

FD OUTPUT-FILE.

WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-EOF PIC X VALUE 'N'.

01 WS-NAME PIC X(30).

01 WS-MONTH-NUM-ED PIC 9(3).

01 WS-INTEREST-ED PIC 9(8).99.
01 WS-PRINCIPAL-ED PIC 9(8).99.
01 WS-BALANCE-ED PIC 9(10).99.

    OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
    OPEN OUTPUT OUTPUT-FILE
    PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = 'Y'
        READ INPUT-FILE
            AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-EOF
        NOT AT END
            PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
        END-READ
    END-PERFORM
    CLOSE INPUT-FILE
    CLOSE OUTPUT-FILE
    STOP RUN.

    UNSTRING INPUT-REC DELIMITED BY ALL ';'

             WS-NAME
             WS-LOAN-AMOUNT
             WS-PROP-VALUE
             WS-DOWN-PAYMENT
             WS-TERM
             WS-RATE
    END-UNSTRING

        STRING "DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT"

            INTO OUTPUT-REC(11:200)
        END-STRING
        WRITE OUTPUT-REC
    ELSE

        MOVE WS-ID TO OUTPUT-REC(1:10)
        STRING "APPRO"
            DELIMITED BY SIZE
            INTO OUTPUT-REC(11:200)
        END-STRING
        WRITE OUTPUT-REC

        COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-RATE = WS-RATE / 1200 ROUNDED
        COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT = WS-LOAN-AMOUNT * WS-MONTHLY-RATE /

        MOVE WS-LOAN-AMOUNT TO WS-BALANCE
        PERFORM VARYING WS-MONTH-NUM FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-MONTH-NUM > WS-TERM
            COMPUTE WS-INTEREST = WS-BALANCE * WS-MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED
            COMPUTE WS-PRINCIPAL = WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT - WS-INTEREST ROUNDED
            COMPUTE WS-BALANCE = WS-BALANCE - WS-PRINCIPAL ROUNDED
            * Prepare formatted fields
            MOVE WS-MONTH-NUM TO WS-MONTH-NUM-ED
            MOVE WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT TO WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT-ED
            MOVE WS-INTEREST TO WS-INTEREST-ED
            MOVE WS-PRINCIPAL TO WS-PRINCIPAL-ED
            MOVE WS-BALANCE TO WS-BALANCE-ED
            STRING WS-MONTH-NUM-ED " "
                   WS-MONTHLY-PAYMENT-ED " "
                   WS-INTEREST-ED " "
                   WS-PRINCIPAL-ED " "
                   WS-BALANCE-ED DELIMITED BY SIZE
                   INTO OUTPUT-REC
            END-STRING
            WRITE OUTPUT-REC
        END-PERFORM
    END-IF.
EOF
